title: Member Repair Discount Recapture on Comfort Club Cancellation
content:
When a Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements agreement is cancelled, member repair discounts the member received during the current term are recaptured once they reach a threshold. The rule reads the member repair discount lines posted on the member's service calls under Repair and Emergency Service Calls.

**Window.** The current-term window takes in discounts posted fewer whole calendar months before the date of handling than the whole calendar months elapsed since the term began, plus one.

## Discount recapture rule
The discount recapture is the member repair discounts posted within the current-term window, multiplied by the discount recapture rate and rounded to the cent half up.

| Total member repair discounts in the window | Discount recapture rate |
|---|---|
| At least 250.00 USD (the full recapture threshold) | 1.0 — recaptured in full |
| At least 100.00 USD (the partial recapture threshold) but below 250.00 | 0.4 |
| Below 100.00 USD | not recaptured |

## Examples (hypothetical totals)
- 260.00 of member repair discounts: 260.00 multiplied by 1.0 recaptures 260.00.
- 180.00: 180.00 multiplied by 0.4 recaptures 72.00.
- 250.00 exactly: the full rate applies, recapturing 250.00.
- 99.99: not recaptured.
